supplementaryReferences.note: The account records fish-stunning use. No such use is recommended, and no household fruit food claim is made.

productionGuidance.products: young leaves reported edible — specialist review needed
care: Keep this tree in mapped inventory and do not count it as household food until identity and a safe edible-leaf preparation are reviewed.
SANBI describes humid coastal/estuarine conditions and no tolerance of even mild frost.
purchase: Ask a specialist nursery about lawful provenance and local site fit. Resolve the food-use question before purchasing it as a household crop.

sourceChecks.observations: Read indexed primary SANBI page content. Direct PlantZAfrica requests in this audit returned HTTP 403; this is not a claim that every individual endpoint was live-tested.

gaps: No safe leaf preparation, harvest months or food kg. Seed, bark, wood and root poison must not be omitted from guidance.
